title: Social Equity and Justice

creators.name: Naseem Akhter, Syed Hamid Farooq Bukhari, Shakir Hussain, Shumaila Rafiq and Arshad Munir

summary: Social Equity and Justice - A Framework for the 21st Century articulates the importance of fairness and accessibility in our current world. Too many people are invisible and have minimal freedom and autonomy. We are called to make the invisible visible and remove the yoke of oppression. People clamor for a way out of the mire that afflicts their lives and seek to be free of injustice and oppression. This book aims to cover how we can bring relief to the masses by pursuing justice, freedom, and equity. Topics include social justice, dismantling oppression, and achieving social equity. Being able to adapt and pivot to a secure footing is essential for any human being. Again, this book aims to make the invisible visible and dismantle oppression and injustice so individuals have a space where they thrive in equity and justice. Social justice is more than a term; it is a mission to fight for human rights.
